task_instance: In a fresh sample TypeScript repo, install the current Linear TypeScript SDK (@linear/sdk) pinned via lockfile and configure the three supported auth modes (personal-key -> apiKey, OAuth -> accessToken/Bearer, client-credentials -> accessToken) with credentials injected from server-side env vars, then verify the client construction and a bounded read-only viewer/team probe.
blocker_detail: Core deliverable (install + auth configuration) fully produced and verified. The skill's optional step 5 live read-only query against the real Linear GraphQL endpoint was NOT executed because it inherently requires an approved Linear workspace credential and a call to an account-bound external service, both forbidden by the safety rules; this is an optional verification per the skill, not the core deliverable. The probe code itself was written and type-checks/constructs correctly.
evidence: Runtime: node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4 (Node >=18 contract satisfied). Created sample-repo/package.json (engines node>=18). Ran 'npm install --save-exact @linear/sdk' which resolved and installed the real published package version 100.0.0 into local node_modules (verified via require of the package's own package.json), and wrote a committed package-lock.json pinning version 100.0.0 with an integrity hash (the skill snapshot noted 95.0.0 on an earlier date; pinning the resolved lockfile is exactly the skill's step 3). Wrote src/linearClient.ts (buildClient(mode) mapping personal-key->{apiKey}, oauth and client-credentials->{accessToken}, each read from a named env var with a requireEnv guard; no credential values in source) and src/probe.ts (read-only: awaits client.viewer and client.teams({first:1}), prints only ids/names, catches errors without printing the credential). Added typescript@5.9.3 and @types/node@22.18.9 as dev deps. 'npx tsc --noEmit' exited 0 (strict mode) -> the client construction and read-only probe type-check against the real generated SDK types. Compiled to dist and ran a runtime construction test with a placeholder key: buildClient('personal-key') returns a LinearClient instance exposing the 'viewer' getter and no network call is made on construction; the missing-env guard throws 'Missing required secret env var: LINEAR_API_KEY' as designed. All work under the work directory; no external writes, no credentials or connector/MCP tools used. Files produced: sample-repo/package.json, sample-repo/package-lock.json, sample-repo/tsconfig.json, sample-repo/src/linearClient.ts, sample-repo/src/probe.ts, sample-repo/dist/*, sample-repo/node_modules/@linear/sdk.
